description: MARV V2 Rev 1 was flight-tested on my 7-inch quadcopter. I validated the onboard flight control, position hold, waypoint flight, and logging on the assembled board. The RP2354B flight computer pairs an ICM-45686 IMU, an LSM6DSK320X ±320 g high-g IMU, and a BMP581 barometer with four-bit microSD over PIO, PSRAM, USB-C, a separate sensor LDO, and a plug-on 5 V converter. The design builds on what I learned from V1’s rocket telemetry and bench tests. Drag to explore the PCB in 3D.
